newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Feb trade deficit $1.242 bln, up 20.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Feb trade deficit $1.242 bln, up 20.6 pct.

text.p: Turkey's trade deficit was up 20.6 percent in February to $1.242 billion from $1.030 billion a year earlier, the State Statistics Institute said.
Exports in February fell 1.1 percent year-on-year to $1.747 billion and imports climbed 6.9 percent to $2.988 billion, the office said.
In the January-February period, the trade deficit totalled $2.597 billion, up 12.6 percent from $2.307 billion a year earlier.
Exports rose 6.1 percent in the two months to February to $3.717 billion, while imports were up 8.7 percent to $6.315 billion from $5.810 billion, the office said.
A foreign trade official said on Wednesday the level of exports in January would be revised upwards to around $1.9 billion from the $1.7 billion announced previously.
